select: SELECT u.*, IF( TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, u.created_at, NOW()) <= 24 OR ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_signup s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session c WHERE c.user_id = u.id) <= 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_record q WHERE q.user_id = u.id) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_order o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) = 0 ), 1, 0) AS is_new_user FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{userId}
